Actinic keratoses. Diclofenac sodium 3% in hyaluronic acid gel is used1-3 in the treatment of actinic keratoses (see Basal Cell and Squamous Cell Carcinoma, p.673), and a meta-analysis4 found it to be of benefit, despite previous concerns that the prep- aration may not be significantly more effective than hyaluronic acid gel alone.5 An open-label comparison involving 30 patients with multiple actinic keratoses suggested that 90 days of treat- ment with diclofenac sodium 3% gel (to lesions on one side of the face and scalp) was better tolerated, but slightly less effective, than 28 days of treatment with fluorouracil 5% cream (to lesions on the other side).6 1.
